faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIEST Shibpur Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Senior Research Fellow position at IIEST Shibpur is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech degree in relevant fields or an M.Sc. degree in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or Life Sciences, along with a valid GATE/NET score and a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position is 32 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 42,000 to Rs. 54,600, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIEST Shibpur Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to be prepared for both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIEST Shibpur located?
faq.answer: IIEST Shibpur is located in Howrah, West Bengal, with the pincode 711103.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Senior Research Fellow recruitment at IIEST Shibpur is CH 1953.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow position is scheduled to be held on 11th September 2026.
